what: the exit policy at the refit temperatures (4-calibration.json): (a) effort=auto's per-exit thresholds, (b) the single-number tau that the default cascade (multi-question requests, no effort) and a one-number confidence_threshold use
dev_sets: as for v6.0-VL (data/v6.0-vl_recipe/6-exit-policy.json b_thresholds.dev_sets), after the exclusion in 4-calibration.json. The image development rows have no case id and are used unfiltered; images always exit at layer 32, so they enter every candidate equally and cannot move a threshold.

auto.script: scripts/select_exit_policy.py thresholds (A selects, B confirms), then thresholds --eval (one evaluation read)
auto.rule: v6.0-VL's rule unchanged: grid tau16 {.59 .65 .7 .75 .8 .85 .9 .95} x tau20 {.5 .59 .7 .8}; C1 suite-like depth <= 24, C2 suite-like U >= fixed 32 - .003, C3 held-out accuracy >= fixed 32 - .003; max shift-matched U on A (ties within .002: lower depth, lower tau16, tau20); confirmed when the A winner meets C1-C3 on B and its B shift-matched U beats the cascade at 0.59
auto.check: the same code on v6.0-VL's dumps reproduces v6.0-VL's thresholds (0.95 / 0.59, confirmed) and temperatures (logT 0.63 / 0.68 / 0.80)

single.why: v6.0-VL's single tau, 0.59, does not transfer: at the refit temperatures the early exits are sharper, and 0.59 sends about 77% of evaluation questions to layer 16 (held-out set 0.7183, final ECE 0.0615 in the served package)
single.rule: written before the fit: the auto rule above restricted to one tau at both early exits, tau in {.50 .59 .65 .70 .75 .80 .85 .90 .95}; if no member is feasible on A, or the A winner fails on B, the fallback is 0.95 (the most conservative member), stated as not confirmed

result.winner_on_B: fails C1: depth 24.08 > 24 (C2 and C3 hold; sm_U 0.6155 > 0.6008)
result.stated_not_selected: 0.80 passed C1-C3 on both halves (B depth 23.28, sm_U 0.6132); the rule picks 0.95
